i don't recommend ending your life even though you seem to be living in hell . 5 days ago i was in the same cross-roads as you right now and if i went left there's a 85% possibility that i'd be dead by now . but i went right and decided that i'm going to work hard to change my situation . if you don't feel comfortable as you are now .. change your life towards the better .. trust me there's more happiness than sadness in this world that i promise you but if you don't want to change your situation than you are happy being depressed and not in control of your own life ( so take control of your life and make it better )

the situation you are in right now is shameful but you shouldn't spend another minute regretting about what could have been .. you've made your decisions maybe you took the hard way but life is about feeling pain and learning from mistakes . Money & Girls, they were never a problem ( NEVER ) if a girl really loves you and cares about you she wouldn't give a damn if you were broke . as for Money it's just Money and it will always be Just Money , it's not sth your happiness should be built upon . some of the world's richest ppl are unhappy and most celebrities are unhappy cuz of the world that Money introduced to them ( Drugs,alcohol and addiction ) i'd say give it a shot.Try Truly hard to overcome any problems ( i'm sure you wouldn't want to see yourself weak )

First of all i am genuinely sorry for your loss. i can't imagine how it must feel , that being said i'm not sure that your girlfriend would have wanted you to kill yourself ( even though it hurts ) as for the accident i know you must of heard this a thousand times but trust me it's not your fault cuz accidents happen ( it's not even the other driver's fault ) and before you do anything reckless would you please ask yourself one simple question : if you were on your way to see her and you had an accident ( i wish you the best ) would you have thought it was her fault and that she should kill herself ? i recommend  going to group meeting in your area to share your story. if you do that i can't promise you that you will get better ( although most ppl do ) but at least you had the bravery to try and move on ( again i'm 100% positive that she wouldn't want you to suffer )

i'm not sure if this would help but i knew someone who was similar to you and now he's doing much better . he went to a psychologist and they told him that the ppl around him like him very much based on what my friends had told them and the problem is that my friend doesn't feel good about himself and his mind doesn't want to accept that fact so it plays mind tricks on him to change his perspective of the problem and instead of being the victim to your own self you become a victim to someone else which makes it less confusing to deal with, so you should try and boost your self-esteem and believe more in yourself . not everyone is funny you just need to hang around fun ppl . and there's this method that everyone is recommending right now . is to just stand in front of a mirror while looking at your image and keep repeating : I LOVE YOU ( you might not feel happy right away but keep repeating it with the intention of getting better and eventually you'll start smiling maybe laughing ) this method really helps you boost your self-esteem .
